runs.name: Box Ships Inc.; OTC TEUFF, formerly NYSE TEU, SEC CIK 0001504795, a Marshall Islands company in Voula, Athens, a 20-F filer; formed to own containerships on time charter, it sold all its vessels in 2016 and then provided commercial management services to two drybulk owners affiliated with its chairman; no active operations by the 6-K of 2018-03-09; Form 15-12B on 2018-04-20, the last 20-F FY2016, nothing filed since; the 20-F names no rival
runs.box: OUT AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$0.00001** a share (OTC Pink close 2026-10-15, volume 0, the last day with volume 2026-03-13; Yahoo chart API through `tools/sources.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **2,913,370** common (the last filed count, 20-F FY2016 Item 4.A, after the 1-for-50 reverse split of 2017-01-31; 2,912,257 at 2016-12-31 on the cover and balance sheet, no treasury shares; later conversions of the 2017 exchange notes on no record); 879,833 Series C 9.00% preferred at $25.00 liquidation preference plus unpaid dividends; cap about **$29** on the last filed count. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-15). Documents read: the 20-F FY2016 (`0001615774-17-001018`) and its 20-F/A (`0001615774-17-001086`, filed to add the missing auditor's name and signature), the 20-Fs FY2011 to FY2015, the 6-Ks of 2017-04-19 to 2018-04-20, the Form 15-12B of 2018-04-20 (`0001615774-18-002778`, 30 holders of record); nothing from the company after 2018-04-20, the website not responding, its 2023 web-archive capture an empty directory. Cross-check: total assets at 2016-12-31 $2,875,705 equal in Item 3.A and the balance sheet. `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` both failed for a deregistered foreign filer; arithmetic by hand. The brief departed in three stated places: lines of evidence derived by the analyst (Items 4.B, 3.D, 5 and 7.B of the last 20-F), rivals from the 20-F's own list, a company that no longer files. **Q1 OUT**: the containership business the FY2011 to FY2015 statements describe was surrendered in 2016, every vessel sold or transferred under lender settlements; what replaced it was a 2% chartering commission from two drybulk owners beneficially owned by the chairman, $11,542 in FY2016 against overhead expected to exceed it, "resulting in an operating cash deficit"; the 6-K of 2018-03-09 says the company "currently has no active operations in the shipping industry", has no credit or other external liquidity and needs capital "to re-commence operations"; the only route to earnings a new start, refused by name **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**, and the past statements cannot tell the future ones **[M2008-033]**, **[M2008-069]**. Contrary reading weighed and set aside by the analyst: TOO HARD (NATURE), no outsider able to see the company since 2018; the analyst reports the framework does not choose between the two. Q2 to Q12 not reached; no research pass. Facts after the stop: the 20-F names no rival ("over 600 independent containership owners"), so no rival was read; debt about $200M in 2011 and 2012, current under waivers from 2013, nil at 2016-12-31 after impairments of $21.6M (FY2015) and $240.0M (FY2016); accumulated deficit $248.4M against paid-in capital $248.6M; the common behind about $20M to $22M of Series C against $0.24M of book equity; going-concern emphasis of matter. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged**: the chairman also President, CEO and Interim CFO; three vessel-owning subsidiaries sold to entities affiliated with him in the 2016 settlement; his companies the managers, the landlord and the only customers after the sales; he held under 1% of the common and 23.7% of the senior Series C; Series C dividends stopped from 2016-04-01 and unrelated holders exchanged preferred for notes at about 15.6% and 11.6% of liquidation value; financing by notes convertible at 60% to 65% of the lowest VWAP; deregistration with 30 holders of record. Owner cash (operating cash less all capital spending) FY2012 to FY2016: -29.9, 38.2, 19.8, 13.2, -9.4 ($M), mean $6.38M, all of it from the surrendered fleet; stock pay inside the figures, noted, not recast. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value range **$0.00 to $0.00** a share (the remaining stream negative, a no-growth case alone, the common floored at nothing), the literal FY2012 to FY2016 window beside, $32.81 a share at 5.43% and $14.36 at ten percent, a value of vessels the company no longer owns and not a case; no case earns the floor; fair **$0.00 all-equity** ($0.00 equity-only); not armed, the box being OUT at Q1. Contamination declared by the analyst: the opening git status and commit subjects naming two other companies, the memory index lines on the queue, one filtered `Test Runs/` listing for TEUFF before the copy that returned nothing, the lock file seen in a listing, not opened; none used. Commits e5c0725f (template), be74fbc7 (Step 0 to Q1), 3c91d728 (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` PASS; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 32 ids, two flags both quote-pairing artefacts of the script (M2000-037 paired with the fragment of M2012-065, its own fragment "where the business will be in 10 years" in its row; M1997-127 cited as a heading with no quotation, the nearest fragment that of M2002-092), no slip, no missing id, no E-id. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) no rule for an issuer that has stopped reporting, where no document exists to read (not WORK) and the NATURE test of the insiders' forecast does not fit, so OUT and TOO HARD (NATURE) are both open readings; (2) whether a former operator that must re-commence operations from no assets is a start-up under Q1, read as one by the analyst, its reading, not a row's; (3) Q7's literal window beside prints a positive figure from an earning base lost inside the window; (4) the template's Step 0 and both tools assume a live filer, and the share count after the 2017 notes is on no record. Could not get: any record after 2018-04-20, the share count after 2017, the OTC Markets profile, web-archive captures for 2018 to 2020.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1 (Box Ships Inc., once NYSE TEU, now an OTC quote at $0.00001 on zero volume; a Greek containership owner that sold or surrendered its whole fleet in 2016 under lender settlements, three vessel subsidiaries going to entities affiliated with its chairman, then earned a 2% commission from two drybulk owners he controls, $11,542 in FY2016 against overhead above it). The 6-K of 2018-03-09: no active operations, no credit, capital needed "to re-commence operations"; Form 15 on 2018-04-20, nothing filed since. The only route to earnings a new start, which the rows refuse. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the chairman's companies on every side (managers, landlord, buyers, the only customers), his 23.7% of the senior preferred against under 1% of the common, preferred exchanged at about 12% to 16% of liquidation value, notes convertible at 60% to 65% of the lowest VWAP. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value $0.00 to $0.00 a share, fair $0.00 all-equity and equity-only, not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: no rule for an issuer that stopped reporting (OUT or TOO HARD (NATURE)), a former operator restarting from nothing read as a start-up, the literal window beside valuing a lost earning base.
